decisions.decision: Start now. Build alongside T-151; don't wait for it. In workshop-plan/tasks, add a features pipeline: (1) a request schema that matches T-151's fields (type, brand/workspace, reporter, steps, attachments) so T-151's intake can feed it directly later; (2) a duplicate merger (embedding/BM25 similarity plus a manual merge override) that stores a demand count and every requester on each merged request; (3) a written rubric in docs/feature-rubric.md (revenue at stake, retention/churn risk, number of paying brands asking, build effort, strategic fit) with weights, applied in code; (4) a weekly decision job that picks build now (24h cycle), write a spec, or park, and logs to coord/LOG.md; (5) a changelog generator per release with per-requester notes saved as drafts.
